_how_to_use: The form the operator fills in, inside the private network, after the V08 dry import.
Copy it to the private root, answer every angle-bracketed value, and keep it there:
every path below is relative to that root, and a configuration outside it is refused.
This copy is refused twice over — by its location in this repository, and because a
placeholder is not a declaration. See plans/msca_dn_v08_original_dry_import_procedure.md.
declared_by: <who reconciled the document and declares these values>
declared_status: <Confirmed, Inferred, Assumed or Unresolved, per CLAUDE.md 12.2>
status_note: <which of these values you reconciled against the PDF, and which you declare without one>
authenticated_sha256: <the hash of the PDF from the authoritative source, the one the dry import was given>

measurement.path: <path of the dry import's inventory, relative to the private root>
measurement.sha256: <that file's sha256; the configuration is bound to one measurement>

dry_import_dir: <directory holding the dry import's records, relative to the private root>
workspace_rel: <the private graph root, relative to the private root>
declarations_dir_rel: <directory for your per-sub-section declaration inputs, relative to the private root>
expected_pages: <the page count the dry import measured>
body_point_size: <the body point size, as the measured distribution spells it>

sub_sections.sub_section_id: <the sub-section's own number, as the document writes it>
sub_sections.marker: <the block prefix that opens it, or null when it opens the document>
sub_sections.declared_title: <a title for an unlabelled sub-section, or null to take it from the heading>

revisions.revision_id: <a plain identifier for this PDF of the document>
revisions.pdf_rel: <the PDF, relative to the private root>
revisions.source_id_prefix: <prefix of this revision's page source ids>
revisions.register_rel: <the fidelity register this revision writes, relative to the private root>
revisions.candidate_role: <what this file is, for the register's input table>
revisions.candidate_version: <which version of the document it is>
revisions.summary: <what this revision is, in one sentence>
